title: Eight Winters and One Short Chair
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）　|　核心词汇：father　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 father 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my uncle ① became a father that no neighbour in the lane would have named, and he said the becoming was the whole of the winter. The ② father, meaning the man himself and not the son, ran eight winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a father, he said, is the only thing in a lane that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ father in that lane had the same short chair beside him, and the ④ father at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the Sunday and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A father, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my uncle said the naming is the part that fills eight winters.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the father was the whole of the house, meaning the head and not the man. The ⑥ father, meaning the head and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody waits for and nobody names; father, she said, is either somebody you become or the only word that means both a man and a head. She said the head is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ father had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ father of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in January, was one lane and eight winters of naming; father, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ father I remember is the one named in the letter, which closed in 1961 and is still described as the quietest in the lane. A ⑩ father, my mother said in 1963, is the only one that improves by being named; every father, she said, is a head that has agreed to look like a man. She said the head was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 父亲（指巷子里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 父亲（指那个人本身，与儿子相对）
C. 固定搭配：become a father 当了父亲
D. n. 父亲（指留给礼拜天的那一位）
E. n. 父亲（抽象总称，指一条巷子的为父之事）
F. n. 父亲（指信上写到、被说出的那一位）
G. n. 家长；一家之主（指一座屋子里人人都等却无人说出的那样东西）
H. n. 一家之主（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说出的那样东西）

items.q: became a father that no neighbour in the lane would have named
The father, meaning the man himself and not the son
the father at the far side
the father was the whole of the house
the father had become a line in a letter
The father of the whole thing
A father, my mother said in 1963

answers.why: become a father 意为“当了父亲”，1951 年叔叔当了一位巷子里没有一位邻居肯说出的父亲。
father 意为“父亲”，指那个人本身而不是儿子，他经过了八个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
father 意为“父亲”，指巷子里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一把短短的椅子。
father 意为“父亲”，指留给礼拜天的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
father 意为“家长、一家之主”，指一座屋子里人人都等却无人说出的那样东西，姑姑说这位家长就是那座屋子的全部。
father 意为“一家之主”，指人人都等却无人说出的那样东西而不是那一位父亲，是屋子里人人都等、却无人说出的东西。
father 意为“父亲”，指信上写到、被说出的那一位，到 1959 年这一位成了信里的一行。
father 意为“父亲”，叔叔一月写道，整件事的为父之事是一条巷子和八个冬天的说出。
father 意为“父亲”，我记得的是信上说出的那一位，1961 年结束了，至今仍被说成巷子里最安静的一位。
father 为抽象总称，母亲 1963 年说，一位父亲是唯一会因为被好好说出而变得更好的东西。
